notes.title: Cage of Etha update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Cage of Etha.
Today, I have fixed some errors in the game.


 Fixed an error where the sound effects continued even after the scene transition.

 Mainly in encounters with Rebekah and the ending scenes.


I hope you'll continue to enjoy Cage of Etha.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2140000/Cage_of_Etha/
